description: Downhill Mayhem race shape — six riders × six concurrent tables (36 sessions) in the Theater. The load client currently drives presence/transport only (channel join, movement, durable commands, reconnect); it does not yet speak activity_join/activity_ready/activity_input, so this measures Theater-room presence and snapshot load, not the authoritative 30 Hz race tick. See docs/downhill-mayhem.md §Load characterization.
